title: Decorator order
Class attribute vs instance attribute
code:

    n = 0
    def bump(self): self.n += 1

a.bump(); a.bump()
print(a.n, b.n, C.n)

title: gather keeps argument order
code:
import asyncio
async def f(n):
    await asyncio.sleep(n / 100)
    print('done', n)
    return n
async def main():
    print(await asyncio.gather(f(3), f(1), f(2)))
asyncio.run(main())
